# OpenMarketEval

> Auditable evaluation harness for AI market and major-event forecasting.

## Entry points

- README: README.md
- Chinese README: README.zh-CN.md
- Forecast protocol: docs/protocol.md
- Benchmark design: docs/benchmark-design.md
- Roadmap: docs/roadmap.md
- Live dashboard: https://alfonsobang.github.io/open-market-eval/
- Current live round: live/rounds/2026-08/
- Contributor rules: CONTRIBUTING.md
- Agent skill: skills/forecast-market-events/SKILL.md
- Harbor-style task: integrations/harbor/market-forecast/

## Commands

- Demo: `python -m open_market_eval demo`
- Validate: `python -m open_market_eval validate --questions <jsonl> --forecasts <jsonl>`
- Seal: `python -m open_market_eval seal <files...>`
- Score: `python -m open_market_eval score --forecasts <jsonl> --resolutions <jsonl>`
- Build dashboard: `python -m open_market_eval build-site --output site`

## Safety boundary

Evaluate probabilistic research quality. Do not provide trade execution, investment recommendations, price targets, or guaranteed-return claims.
